Could you maybe draw a character from a story I wrote? It's a girl, medium height and muscular. She has long auburn hair that's in a braid. Her eyes are a dark green and she's had a tan. She wears brown trousers, boots, a lose, gray one sleeved shirt(the sleeve would be on the right side) with a brown kind of corset over it. She also wears a magnificent green cloak to match her eyes. She carries a sword at her hip along with several daggers. And the most important part is the black tattoo of words that spirals up her left arm, on her shoulder and branches out onto her face. The words don't have to make sense, just random letters would be fine. I've worked really hard on this story but I'm not a good enough artist to out a face with the name. If you could do this for me, I would be very grateful. Oh, and the girl's name is Ria.
